Package org.unitseek.knitid.core.api

package org.unitseek.knitid.core.api
Public generator API: generator contracts, identifier types, per-call context, registries, health snapshots and the static non-Spring facade.

This package has no Spring or third-party algorithm dependency and is safe to use from plain Java applications.

Since:
1.0.0
